final: SELECT AVG(avg_ratio), AVG(record_count), AVG(avg_ratio - overall_avg) FROM (SELECT m.Name AS media_type, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name) AS step1 CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg FROM (SELECT AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_ratio FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name)) AS step2 WHERE avg_ratio > overall_avg
